title: Prompt formula: scene + action + atmosphere

body.text: what's in the scene + what's happening + atmosphere/lighting
. Write something 'visible,' not a vague feeling. The more concrete it is, the more accurately the camera captures it.

example: A young woman strolling through a flower field, wind in her hair, golden evening light, warm tone

title: One shot, one idea

body.text: Don't cram multiple events into one shot — it confuses the AI. Keep
. To tell a longer story, break it into several shots and edit them together.

example: One shot: a cat slowly jumping onto a sofa (not 'a cat walks, jumps, then runs out the door')
